purpose: Teach: 友の会/回分/新譜/吹き替え/データー/ゲージ/コンソール/特番

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、商店街の友の会を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Your father established the shopkeeper's association when he founded the business.
lines.style: Gentle, measured cadence. Nostalgic warmth in the voice—a memory held carefully. Slight pause after each phrase, as if turning pages in his mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員研修を毎年二十回分企画された
lines.en: Yes. He organized twenty staff training sessions every single year.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation with underlying respect. Matter-of-fact about the scale of it. Steady, deliberate pacing. A son acknowledging his father's discipline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、レコード店の新譜入荷を心待ちにされた
lines.en: Your father, when he was young, always looked forward to new record releases at the shop.
lines.style: Tender, distant gaze in the voice. Slowed pace on 'looked forward.' A small smile underneath. The detail of a life well-observed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは外国映画の吹き替え版を毎週観られた
lines.en: Yes. He watched foreign films—the dubbed versions—every week without fail.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative. Slight emphasis on the consistency of it. Warm but reflective, like settling into a clear memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、紙の台帳から電子データーへ移行された
lines.en: Your father oversaw the transition from paper ledgers to electronic records.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. The voice carries quiet respect for adaptation. Deliberate pacing. A moment's pause before the shift, honoring how significant it was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは精密ゲージの調整に拘られた
lines.en: Yes. He was meticulous about precision gauge calibration—never cut corners on accuracy.
lines.style: Measured, precise diction matching the subject. Quiet pride in the exactness. Steady voice, grounded. The respect of a son who learned standards from his father.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、コンソール端末の導入を素早くされた
lines.en: Your father adopted console terminals quickly, ahead of most.
lines.style: Admiring, with a note of gentle wonder. Quicker pace on 'quickly'—capturing the swiftness of his father's decision. Warmth underneath the respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業十周年の特番に出演された
lines.en: Yes. He was featured in the company's tenth-anniversary special broadcast.
lines.style: Quiet completion, like closing a chapter gracefully. Respectful, calm. The understated pride of a son recognizing his father's legacy. Gentle finality.
